page_title: MCI 5-1 LUT | Manchester City v Luton 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, John Brooks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
90+3' 5 - 1 Goal! Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) neatly controls a decent pass from Jeremy Doku. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the roof of the net from the edge of the box. 5:1.

90+2' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the right-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Thomas Kaminski, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' Here comes a substitution. Jordan Clark is given a rest as he is replaced by Joseph Johnson (Luton).
88' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Fred Onyedinma is replaced by Zack Nelson (Luton).

87' 4 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 4:1. Thomas Kaminski was helpless.
86' Sergio Gomez (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thomas Kaminski intercepts the ball.
84' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar.

81' 3 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Ross Barkley (Luton) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:1.
81' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Erling Haaland and he is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
81' Sergio Gomez (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kevin De Bruyne.

80' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Alfie Doughty (Luton) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Ederson pulls off a brilliant save.
80' Alfie Doughty (Luton) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
79' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) brings his opponent down. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Luton have a free kick.
77' Substitution. Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) replaces Luke Berry.
76' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Thomas Kaminski no chance!
76' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

75' Fred Onyedinma (Luton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. John Brooks stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. PENALTY AWARDED to Manchester City!
73' He should have scored! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
72' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Erling Haaland, but Thomas Kaminski displays great awareness to stop him.

68' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom right corner, but Thomas Kaminski pulls off a great save to deny him.
66' What a chance that is! Cauley Woodrow (Luton) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!

64' 2 - 0 Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight under the crossbar. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:0.
64' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
63' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
63' Referee John Brooks makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
63' Surely that's handball by one of the Luton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

63' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
60' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) gets a nice pass from Erling Haaland on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Cauley Woodrow (Luton) coming on for Andros Townsend.

58' Mateo Kovacic sprays a wonderful pass out to Ruben Dias (Manchester City), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Thomas Kaminski problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post.
57' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the right post is saved by Thomas Kaminski.
54' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) receives a reproachful look from Rico Lewis. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post.
52' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.

50' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
48' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Alfie Doughty (Luton) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

45' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Thomas Kaminski pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
43' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
43' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
42' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is cleared to safety by the defence.
41' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
39' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
37' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) attempts to find Matheus Nunes, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
35' The corner by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

35' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
32' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.
31' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
31' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
31' 13:0 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 5:0.
29' Jordan Clark (Luton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ederson, who smothers the ball.
29' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner which is cleared.
27' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.

26' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Thomas Kaminski makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
25' Wow, what an escape. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
25' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
23' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
22' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
20' Kevin De Bruyne finds the head of Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies past the right post. Unlucky!

19' Alfie Doughty (Luton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
18' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
17' Erling Haaland receives a sweet pass inside the box from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
16' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

14' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Thomas Kaminski is alert and denies him with a nice save.
13' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) sends a chip pass into the box, but Thomas Kaminski is quickest to intercept the ball.
12' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
10' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
10' The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.

9' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top left corner is blocked by Thomas Kaminski, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
9' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
5' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
3' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
2' 1 - 0 OWN GOAL! Daiki Hashioka (Luton) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 1:0.
2' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

2' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Thomas Kaminski makes a great save to stop his effort.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Luton will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be John Brooks.
